login.title: Sign in to the admin console
login.subtitle: Platform administrators only. Tenant accounts use the user console.
login.expired: Your session expired or was revoked. Please sign in again.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp.recoveryHint: Enter an unused recovery code (like xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx). Each recovery code works once.
totp.expired: Verification timed out (5 minutes). Please sign in again.

changePw.title: Change your password first
changePw.hint: This account must change its password first. All sessions end after the change; sign in again with the new password.
changePw.done: Password changed. Please sign in again.

empty.title: No pages are available to you
empty.description: Pages appear only when their module is delivered, you hold the permission and the run mode allows it. Ask an administrator if you need access.

forbidden.title: No permission
forbidden.description: Your account lacks the permission required for this page.
forbidden.contact: Contact an administrator if you need access.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page does not exist or is not available.

search.title: Global search
search.hint: ↑↓ to select, Enter to open, Esc to close

empty.title: Nothing to search yet
empty.description: Search only covers pages you can open.

account.logoutConfirm: Signing out closes all tabs. Unsaved changes will be lost. Sign out anyway?

confirm.title: Close a tab with unsaved changes?
confirm.body: “{title}” has unsaved changes that will be lost.

mobile.complexEdit: Complex editing (rule conditions, website design, …) works on a phone but the experience is not guaranteed; use a desktop for it.

rule.email: {field} is not a valid email address
rule.same: The two {field} values do not match
rule.url: {field} must be a URL starting with http:// or https://
rule.timezone: {field} must be a valid IANA time zone name
rule.locales: Select at least one language for {field}

auth.invalid_credentials: Wrong email or password, or this account cannot use this entry.
auth.totp_invalid: The code is wrong, or the recovery code was already used.
auth.unauthenticated: Your sign-in is invalid or timed out. Please sign in again.
auth.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
auth.pw_policy: The new password does not meet the strength policy.
auth.reauth_required: This is a sensitive action: verify your identity first.

rate_limit.exceeded: Too many attempts. Please try again later.

client.reauth_cancelled: Re-verification was cancelled. The action was not performed.

resource.not_found: The object does not exist or was deleted.
resource.conflict: The action conflicts with the current state. Refresh and try again.
resource.precondition_failed: The data was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.

idempotency.key_reuse: The same request was submitted twice with different content. Reopen the dialog and try again.

feature.disabled: This feature is not enabled in the current run mode.

danger.reauthHint: This action also needs identity re-verification: if you have not verified recently, you will be asked for your credentials again after you submit.
danger.audit: This action is recorded in the audit log (operator, time, object, Request ID).

reauth.title: Verify your identity
reauth.description: This is a sensitive action and needs your identity verified again. You will not be asked again for a while after it succeeds.

oneTime.once: This is shown only once. You cannot view it again after closing. Copy it now and keep it safe.
oneTime.copyFailed: The browser blocked automatic copying. Select the text above and copy it manually.

problem.order: The start time cannot be later than the end time

audit.aliasNote: The "user operations" preset filter is applied (resource type = user). You can clear it below.

users.scope: Manage platform administrator accounts here. Creating, promoting, resetting credentials and deleting are high-risk and require identity re-verification and are audited.

create.title: New administrator
create.initialHint: Leave empty to get a one-time temporary credential generated by the system, shown once. It must be changed at first sign-in.
create.reauthHint: Creating an administrator requires identity re-verification.

roles.title: Assign roles: {name}
roles.none: There are no platform roles to assign (or you cannot view roles).
roles.reauthHint: Changing roles (including promotion) requires identity re-verification.

toast.reset: Credential reset. The user must change it at the next sign-in

disable.title: Disable {name}?
disable.impact: This account will no longer be able to sign in and its sessions end. You can enable it again at any time.

revoke.title: Revoke all sessions of {name}?
revoke.impact: All sign-in sessions of this user end immediately and they must sign in again.

reset.title: Reset the credential of {name}?
reset.impact: All sessions of this user end immediately and the user is forced to change the credential at the next sign-in. A system-generated temporary credential is shown only once.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.impact: The account is deleted and its roles and sessions are removed. Historical audit records are kept. This cannot be undone.

reset.manualHint: Leave empty to have the system generate one, shown once. When set, use 12-128 characters.

once.description: Hand it to the user over a secure channel. The user must change it at the first sign-in.
once.label: Temporary credential

roles.builtinNote: Built-in roles cannot be changed. Their permissions are shown read-only.

delete.title: Delete role {name}?
delete.impact: Role {code} will be deleted. A role that still has holders cannot be deleted: remove it from them first. This cannot be undone.

matrix.title: Permission matrix
matrix.notApplicable: Not applicable to this role scope
matrix.reauthHint: Changing role permissions requires identity re-verification. You can only grant permissions you hold yourself.

roles.noneSelected: Select a role to view or edit its permissions.

create.title: New role
create.codeHint: Starts with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, digits and underscores only; 2-64 characters.
create.codeInvalid: The code must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores (2-64 characters)
create.reauthHint: Creating a role requires identity re-verification. Assign permissions in the matrix afterwards.

tokens.scope: Manage your own API tokens here. The token is shown in plain text only once, when created; only a hash is stored.

empty.title: No API tokens yet
empty.description: Once created, a token lets scripts and integrations call the API. Its scopes cannot exceed your own permissions.

create.title: Create API token
create.scopesHint: You can only pick permissions you hold yourself; at least one.
create.cidrs: Allowed source networks (optional, one per line or comma-separated)
create.expiresHint: Leave empty to use the system default lifetime.
create.expiresInvalid: The expiry must be in the future

rotate.title: Rotate token "{name}"?
rotate.impact: A new token is generated and the old one is revoked at once, so scripts using the old token will fail. The new token is shown only once.

revoke.title: Revoke token "{name}"?
revoke.impact: The token stops working immediately and cannot be restored. Scripts using it will fail.

once.description: The full token is below. Copy it now and store it somewhere safe.
once.label: Full token

settings.readonly: You do not have permission to change system settings. This page is read-only.

hint.general_base_url: Used by node enrollment tokens and gRPC certificates. Changing it affects node enrollment and requires identity re-verification.
hint.general_timezone: An IANA time zone name, for example Asia/Shanghai. Storage and the API always use UTC.
hint.general_registration_open: Only effective in commercial mode; changing it requires identity re-verification.

mode.title: Run mode
mode.desc: Self-hosted mode hides commercial features; commercial mode opens tenants, billing and more. Switching needs no migration, but it changes the visible features and APIs at once.

impact.commercial: After switching to commercial mode, commercial features (tenant self-registration, billing and more) are opened up, and menus and APIs change immediately.
impact.self_hosted: After switching to self-hosted mode, commercial features are hidden and their APIs immediately answer "feature not enabled".

brand.desc: Brand settings are shared by Admin and the website. After saving, the top bar reads the new brand name at once.
brand.mediaNote: Logo and favicon are media assets, uploaded through the website CMS (P2). Saving keeps the current ones unchanged.

login.desc: Sign-in and session policy. These are security-sensitive, so saving requires identity re-verification.
login.crossSession: The idle timeout cannot exceed the absolute timeout

field.login_throttle_account_max: Max failures per account in the window
field.login_throttle_ip_max: Max failures per IP in the window

hint.login_totp_required_for_admin: When on, administrators without TOTP can only enter the enrollment flow.
hint.auth_reauth_window_s: After a sensitive action is verified, you are not asked again within this time.
